name: Golden Rose (Red)
description: Rose, a plant in the Rosaceae family, has thorns on its branches and extremely delicate and fragrant flowers. It is often given the meaning of love. In Greek mythology, it is the embodiment of love and beauty. Roses symbolize romance, and couples often express their feelings by giving roses. Different colors and numbers of roses represent different meanings. Red roses represent passion and love for you, and the flower language of a single rose is "only love one person in your life." Present a golden rose to the one you love, and let the flowers convey all the love and affection.
